resources.name: FCC and BCC calcium crystal structure parameters

access.notes: Standard crystallographic values: FCC lattice parameter a0 ≈ 5.58 Å at ambient pressure; BCC lattice parameter at transition ≈ 0.95 a0 (volume change ~2%). Publicly available in standard databases or textbooks.
